title: thelypteris marattioides
intro: Thelypteris marattioides, commonly known as the Lady Fern, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris marattioides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a popular remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
